Today, we will hold our fourth and final post-session bill signing ceremony of the year. 

I will sign into law the Maryland Housing Certainty Act, the Maryland Transit and Housing Opportunity Act, the Joanne C. Benson Maryland Phone-Free Schools Act, and other legislation focused on housing, community development, and education.

go.md.gov/FourthBillSigning

Today, we honor the 13 service members who made the ultimate sacrifice this year in the Iran War.

They remind us what courage looks like. Their legacy endures in every Marylander that raises their hand and puts on the uniform and their names will always be remembered.

Video

Thank you, Valley Forge Military Academy, for all you gave me and every cadet who called your campus ‘home.’

Video

We are proud to stand with our veterans, service members, military families, caregivers, and Gold Star families today.

Thank you to Secretary Rothstein and the entire Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families for your deep commitment to supporting those who served and living up to a simple promise: Leave no one behind.

God bless you all, and God bless the State of Maryland.

Video

Today, I’m thinking of all the service members who’ve made the ultimate sacrifice for our country. People who led with courage, believed in the promise of our country, and put it all on the line to defend our freedom.

Dawn and I pray for them and their families, and we pray for the safety of all our service members who stand watch in harm’s way.

When I ran for governor, I said we’d be an administration that would launch the most aggressive, all-out assault on child poverty this state has ever seen – and I meant it.

At a moment when Washington is failing to address rising costs, ripping away health care, and telling mothers and their children that they’re on their own – Maryland is pushing forward for working families.

Freedom of expression is alive and well in the Free State of Maryland because of advocates like Mac. 

Because of their work, Maryland is now one of the few states that restricts when prosecutors can rely on rap lyrics as criminal evidence.

Video

In the wake of historic flooding last year, Westernport Elementary had nowhere to finish their school year.

But @FrostburgState stepped in. Elementary school students finished their year on campus at Frostburg – and the whole campus, including the Class of 2026, rallied behind them.

Two of the students who graduated today, Devann and Rebecca, spent WEEKS planning lessons and activities for those children and helping them know they belonged here.

This Memorial Day weekend, we’re expecting over 335,000 vehicles to cross the Bay Bridge.

Everyone's trying to get home to someone – so plan ahead, pay attention to lane signals, and never drive distracted or impaired.

Be kind, be focused, and be safe.


MDTA (@TheMDTA)

Bay Bridge Safety Checks

Maryland students and educators have worked hard, and it's paying off — our schools are LEADING the national comeback in public education. 

But the job’s not done. Maryland plays to win. 

We're going to keep investing into our schools, close the teacher shortage, and deliver on our promise to have the best public schools in America.

They deserve to live in safety and security.
